utility.notes: Visalia is confirmed as SCE territory via multiple corroborating sources this session (the Visalia Chamber of Commerce's own utility-member listing for SCE, and SCE program listings specific to Visalia), consistent with SCE's service territory extending into parts of Tulare County alongside neighboring Central Valley cities like Tulare, Porterville, Exeter, Farmersville, Lindsay, and Woodlake.

generation_supplier.notes: No official Visalia city page or CCA program page confirming CCA membership was found this session. Left null rather than guessed.

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Visalia/Tulare County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

eligibility_constraints.notes: The page refers applicants to SolarAPP+'s own general eligible-systems guide rather than stating a specific size cap or property-type restriction itself.

permit_fees.notes: The page does not list specific permit costs, referring applicants to SolarAPP+'s own general cost information instead.
